rules.source_package_name: DSi BIOS, firmware, and NAND image
rules.notes: Standalone melonDS DSi mode requires manually dumped DSi BIOS, firmware, and NAND files; Lunchbox does not have a Minerva source package for these yet.
Import a raw prod.keys file or a ZIP containing prod.keys and optional title.keys from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates and installs the keys into Eden's active profile.
Import a firmware ZIP dumped from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates NCA content and installs it into Eden's active NAND profile.
Import a raw prod.keys file or a ZIP containing prod.keys and optional title.keys from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates and installs the keys into Ryubing's active system profile.
Import a firmware ZIP dumped from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates NCA content and installs it into Ryubing's active BIS profile.
Import a raw prod.keys file or a ZIP containing prod.keys and optional title.keys from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates and installs the keys into Torzu's active profile.
Import a firmware ZIP dumped from the user's own Nintendo Switch. Lunchbox validates NCA content and installs it into Torzu's active NAND profile.
M88kai needs PC-8801 BIOS ROMs in the emulator directory. Lunchbox exposes a managed import folder, but does not auto-install this standalone BIOS layout yet.
Tsugaru needs FM Towns ROM assets plus a CMOS image. Lunchbox exposes a managed import folder, but Tsugaru's standalone ROM/CMOS layout remains manual.
UNZ needs FM Towns ROM assets plus cmos.dat in its emulator directory. Lunchbox exposes a managed import folder, but UNZ remains manual-only.
The standalone Emu5 Sord M5 path still expects BIOS ROMs in the emulator directory. Lunchbox exposes a managed import folder instead of guessing the final layout.
DEmul expects the Atomiswave BIOS romset to be added through its Roms and Bioses Paths configuration. Lunchbox exposes a managed import folder instead of mutating DEmul directly.
